name: Felipe Flip
bio: Builder in the Nouns ecosystem through Flows with SensatioNouns, BlackChain, and Roots of Love projects. Co-founder of ICE Institute. Skater, singer, songwriter, rapper with a RapJazz band and Hardcore/Rap band, plus DJ/music selector. Also stream live reactions to skate videos and games. Web3 enthusiast spreading nounish culture worldwide through my random adventures.
